The '''''Flying Fish''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] owned by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It was used by a group of Rebels on their [[Mission to Tazan|mission]] to infiltrate and destroy the [[Imperial Data Processing Facility]] on [[Tazan]]. To provide a plausible cover story, the starship was loaded with low-grade medical supplies, while explosives were stored in a number of secret compartments located under the deck plating.
